summary: Read a SchoolPass parent account directly with curl against the regional SchoolPass REST API (a busapi shard on school-pass.net), without running the MCP server. Use for a one-off shell read of your students, arrival/dismissal calendar, pending pickup changes, drivers, dismissal locations, or school info — "check SchoolPass from the terminal", "list my kids in SchoolPass", "any dismissal changes today". Requires SCHOOLPASS_EMAIL / SCHOOLPASS_PASSWORD / SCHOOLPASS_SCHOOL_CODE.
